test_title: PYST 1: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - Quant (Held On 24 Jul, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question:
Consider the following two statements, labeled Assertion (A) and Reason (R). Evaluate them and choose the appropriate answer from the given options.**
Assertion (A):** Two non-intersecting and non-touching circles have four common tangents.**
Reason (R):** Two direct and two transverse tangents can be drawn between such circles.

options.text: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true, but R is false
A is false, but R is true

solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Non-intersecting & non-touching circles ⇒ separate circles

Such circles have 4 common tangents

2 direct + 2 transverse tangents

Assertion is true, Reason correctly explains it

**∴ Answer = Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Two non-intersecting and non-touching circles

**Formula used:**

Number of common tangents depends on position of circles

 
• 
• 
• 
• Direct Tangents Transverse Tangents 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Non-intersecting, non-touching circles ⇒ separate circles

⇒ Number of tangents = 4

⇒ Types: 2 direct + 2 transverse

⇒ Assertion is true

⇒ Reason correctly explains the Assertion

**∴ The correct answer is: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Number of Common Tangents

Separate circles ⇒ 4 tangents, Touch externally ⇒ 3, Intersect ⇒ 2, Touch internally ⇒ 1, One inside another ⇒ 0.

Direct Tangents

Tangents that do not intersect the line joining centers.

Transverse Tangents

Tangents that intersect the line joining centers.

Key Geometry Rule

Always identify relative position of circles to determine number of tangents.
